component.name: Omarchy AI Bar
component.summary: Monitor AI provider usage, quota, cost, and sessions

description.p: Omarchy AI Bar presents provider usage, quota reset times, costs, and agent sessions through an Omarchy bar widget backed by one Rust process.
The backend also offers scriptable command-line output and a StatusNotifierItem fallback when the Omarchy plugin is unavailable.
Ported from CodexBar and customized for Omarchy by Cengiz Han.
CodexBar-style inline usage and cost views, provider configuration, credential isolation, persistent rate-limit backoff, and expanded native provider support.
Full 69-provider daemon and Omarchy UI, operational CLI, Secret Service, local API, hooks, and sandboxed user plugins.
